v0.5.2May 10, 2026

Added

Changed

  • ContentProtein recommendations updated: 1.4-2.2 g/kg/day based on training volume (Witard 2025, Sports Medicine) — previously 1.2-1.8
  • ContentGlucose:fructose ratio modernized: 1:0.8 above 60 g/h (Rowlands 2020) — previously 2:1
  • ContentCarb loading: 36-48 h at 10-12 g/kg (modern protocol) — 3-day method obsolete
  • ContentPost-effort recovery window debunked in calculator and guide: real window is 4-6 h glycogen / 24-48 h protein, not 30 min
  • Content4:1 carb:protein recovery ratio noted as myth (Margolis 2021): the apparent benefit comes from added calories

Fixed

  • CalculatorsFueling calculator gel count now realistic: split 60% gels / 40% sports drink (previously counted 14 gels for a 3h30 marathon at 80 g/h, now 7)
